crossRefs.note: David said to Abishai, “Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your lord’s servants…
They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.
But the people said, “You shall not go out; for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die…
Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may…
I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I…
Nevertheless for David’s sake, Yahweh his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to…
I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Zeruiah
people.line: Sister of David; mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel

translations.web: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah helped him, and struck the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David swore to him, saying, “Don’t go out with us to battle any more, so that you don’t quench the lamp of Israel.”
translations.bsb: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to his aid, struck the Philistine, and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, “You must never again go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel may not be extinguished.”
translations.kjv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the light of Israel.
translations.asv: But Abishai the son of Zeruiah succored him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him. Then the men of David sware unto him, saying, Thou shalt go no more out with us to battle, that thou quench not the lamp of Israel.
